title: Console/Observability triage scratchpad
content:
2026-03-03 - Morning triage notes (wip)

Quick context:
- Mostly personal scratchpad for console/observability triage.
- Focus: dashboard rendering issues + a couple customer reports around metrics gaps.
- Use this to track immediate follow-ups and handoffs to CS/Eng.

TODAY'S PRIORITIES (high -> low):
1) OBS-482: customer (AcmeCorp) report: CPU heatmap panels show long gaps since 03/01 18:00 UTC.
   - Impact: customer-facing metrics missing in support UI; automated alerts suppressed.
   - First pass: checked ingestion pipeline + logs (see commands below). No obvious ingestion lag at collector.
   - Hypothesis: query/aggregation layer (rollup) failing for high-cardinality tags.
   - Next steps: run targeted queries on rollup store for sample host (acme-web-01).
   - Assigned: Jordan to dig into rollup query logs; I will coordinate with CS to gather customer timeseries examples.
   - Note to self: escalate if no progress by EOD.

2) OBS-499: Dashboard thumbnails failing to render intermittently in Console for internal canary users.
   - Symptoms: 502 from thumbnail-service when generating PNGs; retrying succeeded ~30% of time.
   - Logs: thumbnail-service stderr shows occasional OOM on process (heap spikes).
   - Temporary mitigation: increase thumbnail worker memory on canary pool (low risk) -> Priya to patch K8s deployment.
   - Longer term: switch to headless-chrome pool with cached fonts & reduce concurrency.

Notes / commands I ran:
- kubectl -n obs logs deploy/rollup-query --since=2h | grep "error\|timeout" | tail -n 200
  -> saw repeated "timeout on group_by" around 2026-03-02T17:40:xx UTC for queries with tag_count>200
- curl -s 'https://console.internal/api/v1/query?expr=rollup_errors_total%7Bservice="rollup"%7D' | jq .
  -> small spike at ~17:45 UTC (matches customer window)
- ssh to collector-acme-01 -> sudo journalctl -u obs-collector -u agent -n 500
  -> normal, no backlog, last-forwarded ok

Short checklist before handing to eng:
- [ ] collect sample timeseries (AcmeCorp) and share with Jordan (done? need CS confirm)
- [ ] capture full rollup-query trace when reproducing (enable debug for 1 hour)
- [ ] add tag filter to quick dashboard so CS can view degraded panels (temp)

Customer communication (notes to include in update):
- Apologize for missing metrics; giving them ETA for next update (2-3 hours).
- Mention we are investigating rollup aggregation for high-cardinality tags and will share findings.
- Ask for any recent changes on their side (tags, new hosts) since 03/01.

FOLLOW-UPS / ACTION ITEMS:
- Jordan: act on rollup-query logs + try reproducer (query with tag_count > 200) - due 2026-03-03 17:00
- Priya: bump thumbnail worker memory on canary (k8s patch) - aim to deploy by 2026-03-03 12:00, monitor
- Me (Maya): assemble customer timeseries examples + write initial CS note (send before 13:00)
- If OBS-482 unresolved by EOD, schedule quick call with data-platform (ask Sam)

Random notes / debugging fragments (brain dump):
- Could be related to recent rollup change: https://github.com/redwood-inference/rollup/commit/ab12cd3 (check PR 221)
- Consider toggling "use_strict_grouping" flag for a short window to see if query planner changes behavior
- Thumbnail OOMs correlated with specific fonts (noto-sans) + long titles -> try font subset or limit title length

Metric snapshots (copied for record):
- rollup_query_latency_p50: 120ms (baseline 40ms) at 2026-03-02T17:45
- rollup_query_errors_total: +18 within 1h window (mostly 504/timeouts)
- thumbnail_service_ooms: 4 in last 6h (canary pool)

Meeting / handoff log:
- 2026-03-03 09:30 sync with CS (Kaitlyn) - shared initial findings, asked for sample dashboards (she'll DM)
- 2026-03-03 10:15 quick sync with Priya - agreed to memory bump; Priya will monitor post-deploy

Lingering questions (to answer during investigation):
- Is rollup store under memory pressure around the window? (check node-level mem, GC logs)
- Are there any recent schema changes to tags/labels that would explode cardinality?
- Is there throttling in the analytics-query layer for tenant "acme"?

Quick reminders (personal):
- Ping Sam about data-platform call if no progress by 17:00
- Prep short postmortem template if issue spans >24h
- Save console dashboard snapshots to GDrive: link pending

---
Version history / quick edits (scratch):
- 2026-03-01: initial draft for OBS-482 when ticket created
- 2026-03-02: added logs from rollup-query; started reproducer
- 2026-03-03: morning triage edits; assigned tasks to Jordan & Priya

End of scratchpad (for now).
